androidtv.notes: Search by voice: press the mic key on the Search screen, or the search/mic button on your remote where the TV allows it. Also new: Your stats in Settings.

phone.notes: Codio now asks for an access password the first time it opens on a device.

windows.notes: When Codio sits idle, it now shows a slideshow of pictures from your Library and the time. Turn it off or change the wait in Settings, Picture & sound.
